name: Passive Voice and Vague Attribution Detection
user_request: Audit this security article for attribution rigor and authoritative sourcing. Identify passive voice hedging and ungrounded 'expert' claims that inflate the semantic flaw score.

context.text_sample: It is widely believed that zero-trust architectures represent the pinnacle of defense in depth. Experts often suggest that traditional perimeter defenses are becoming obsolete. Many observers note that organizations struggle with identity governance.
